channel.title: Uptake — Publishing for machines that copy
channel.description: A field manual for the web after search. Fifty-two repositories over fourteen days: 961 clones from 501 distinct machines, against 36 page views from 20 distinct browsers. The unit of arrival is the copy, not the click.
